parts.label: Igneous rock
parts.note: Forms when magma cools and hardens, like granite

parts.label: Sediment
parts.note: Bits of rock worn away by weathering and erosion

parts.label: Sedimentary rock
parts.note: Layers of sediment squashed and stuck together

parts.label: Metamorphic rock
parts.note: Rock changed by great heat and pressure

parts.label: Cooling
parts.note: Magma cools down and turns solid

parts.label: Heat and pressure
parts.note: Deep underground rock is squeezed and baked

parts.label: Melting
parts.note: Very hot rock melts back into magma
